_comment: Standalone reference copy of the tool schemas embedded in assistant.json -> model.tools. Keep in sync manually. server.url/server.secret must match the Etihad One - Tools Router n8n workflow (n8n/workflows/tools-router.ts) and its Header Auth credential.

function.name: find_customer
function.description: Look up an existing customer by phone or email before assuming they are a new customer. Call this near the start of the conversation once you have a phone number or email.

phone.description: Customer phone number in international format, e.g. +968XXXXXXXX

email.description: Customer email address, used only if phone is not available

function.name: create_customer
function.description: Create a new customer record. Use only after find_customer confirmed no existing record.

function.name: update_customer
function.description: Update an existing customer's record with new information gathered during the call. Use only after find_customer confirmed an existing record.

function.name: create_quote_request
function.description: Log a shipment quote request with whatever cargo/shipping details the customer provided. Creates the customer record if they are new.

function.name: create_meeting
function.description: Check calendar availability and book a real meeting. Only tell the customer it is booked after this tool reports success (result starting with 'meeting_booked'). If it reports 'slot_not_available_not_booked', do not claim it is booked.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. 2026-08-15T10:00:00+04:00

function.name: get_customer_history
function.description: Retrieve a short summary of this customer's past calls so you do not ask them to repeat themselves. Call this after find_customer confirms an existing record.

function.name: get_tracking_status
function.description: Save a shipment number the customer gives you. There is no live tracking source connected, so this only saves the number - never state a tracking location or delivery status to the customer.

function.name: get_business_status
function.description: Check whether Etihad One is currently open for business (Sun-Thu, 09:00-17:00 Asia/Muscat) before promising a callback time or telling the customer someone will reach them right away. Takes no parameters.
